name: GYEN
oneLiner: GYEN is GMO Trust's NYDFS-chartered JPY stablecoin; multiple 2021 depegs led to a 2026 class-action settlement covering NY and CA holders.
collateral: Japanese yen reserves held in FDIC-insured financial institutions, government money-market funds, or U.S. Treasury bills (≤3 months to maturity) per NYDFS guidelines
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for JPY through GMO Trust (NYDFS-chartered trust company)

notices.title: 2021 depeg and 2026 class-action settlement
notices.message: GYEN suffered multiple de-pegging events shortly after its 2021 launch (notably hitting >1.5x its peg in May 2021), causing material holder losses on Coinbase. A class action filed in 2022 (Donovan v. Coinbase / GMO Trust) led to a $6.75M proposed settlement; motion for final approval was filed on April 17, 2026 with a final-approval hearing set for May 27, 2026. Settlement class covers GYEN purchasers in New York or California between Dec 29, 2020 and Oct 10, 2025. Methodology-relevant historical record of peg failure for an otherwise NYDFS-supervised issuer.
